description:
FILED s543q (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-28, CODE 6a1301ed = MAIN-READY-114 + records, v2-16500) by the Rosetta census B (docs/rosetta-plan.md section 6b; #2104).

THE SHAPE (neutral reproducer, run on the tree, perl 5.40.3 vs PCL):

    my @l = (3, 4);
    my $x = { map { $_ => 1 } @l }->{4};
    print "$x\n";
    print "no\n" if not { map { $_ => 1 } @l }->{5};

    perl: 1
          no
    PCL : 1
          Not a HASH reference          (exit 255; line 2 -- the same constructor after `=` -- is right)

PPI (vendored pcl branch) -- the brace after a PREFIX operator is a Block, not a Constructor (rule 13's token dump):

    print 1 if not { a => 1 }->{b};   ... Operator(not) Structure::Block({ a => 1 }) Operator(->) Structure::Subscript({b})
    my $y = !{ a => 1 }->{b};         ... Operator(!)   Structure::Block({ a => 1 }) Operator(->) Structure::Subscript({b})
    expected: Structure::Constructor -- in TERM position perl's `{` is an anonymous hash (toke.c), and an operator leaves the
              tokenizer expecting a term

    PCL then emits `(p-not (p-gethash-deref (p-map (lambda ($_) ... (vector $_ 1)) @l) 5))` -- the block's statement, a list, is
    dereferenced as if it were a hash reference.

Neighbour (filed before, rare, a different site): #286, `f { ... }` after a paren-less user sub.
NEEDS THE USER'S WORD: a PPI mis-lex (rule 13: fixed on the vendored branch with a docs/ppi-upstream-bugs.md section and a
docs/ppi-bug-report.t row), and the PPI program is CLOSED (docs/ppi-fix-at-source-s527.md section 11).  A PCL-side repair
(a Block whose previous significant token is an operator that expects a term, followed by `->{` / `->[`, re-tagged as a
Constructor) would be the alternative the ruling has to choose between.

CHEAP DISCRIMINATING MEASUREMENT (taken): 0493 with the set built first (`my %seen = map { $_ => 1 } @$test; not $seen{$_}`) is byte-identical to perl -- its only cause (the program's `#!/usr/bin/perl -l` switch is honoured).

PROGRAMS: 0493-Find-first-missing-positive.
frequency_reason: Rosetta: 0493-Find-first-missing-positive (`first { not { map { $_ => 1 } @$t }->{$_} } 1 .. @$t + 1`, a set-membership idiom)
subject: LOUD: an anonymous-hash constructor right after a unary `not` / `!` is lexed by PPI as a BLOCK -- `not { map { $_ => 1 } @l }->{$k}` dies "Not a HASH reference" (PCL dereferences the map's LIST); after `=` the same constructor is right (Rosetta 0493)
triage_reason: an anonymous hash in term position is core language (perlref), IN by docs/supported-subset.md section 3; a PPI mis-lex: the fix needs the USER's word (the PPI program is closed)
